## Section: Joshua's Lament Over Moses

- **EMET:** And when Joshua had heard these things, he tore his garments and fell at the feet of Moses...

- **PNEUMA:** When Joshua had heard all these things, he tore his garments and fell at Moses' feet and b...
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS preferred for formal clarity.

### Verse 11:2
- **EMET:** O Moses, why have you comforted me? And how shall I be able to remain without you?
- **LOGOS:** O Moses, why have you comforted me? And how shall I be able to continue without you?
- **PNEUMA:** O Moses, why have you tried to comfort me? How can I go on without you?
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS preferred for formal clarity.

### Verse 11:3

- **LOGOS:** Who will provide food for this multitude? Or who will be their shepherd?
- **PNEUMA:** Who will feed this vast multitude? Who will be their shepherd?
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS preferred for formal clarity.

### Verse 11:4
- **EMET:** Who will have compassion on them and will lead them in the way they should go?
- **LOGOS:** Who will have compassion on them and guide them on the way they should go?
- **PNEUMA:** Who will have compassion on them and lead them in the right way?
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS preferred for formal clarity.

### Verse 11:5
- **EMET:** Who will pray on their behalf when they have sinned and will intercede for them?
- **LOGOS:** Who will pray on their behalf when they sin and will make intercession for them?
- **PNEUMA:** Who will pray for them when they sin and make intercession on their behalf?

- **LOGOS:** And who will make intercession for them and ask pardon for their sins?
- **PNEUMA:** And who will intercede for them and ask forgiveness for their sins?

- **PNEUMA:** For you are about to leave us, and where will those who fear God turn for comfort?
